parameters.query:
SELECT source, jobs_seen, jobs_matched, applications_sent
  FROM daily_metrics
 WHERE day = CURRENT_DATE - 1
 ORDER BY source;

SELECT j.title, j.company, j.url, j.location, j.source, m.score, m.summary
  FROM jobs j
  JOIN match_results m ON m.job_id = j.id
 WHERE j.discovered_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
   AND m.score >= 70
 ORDER BY m.score DESC
 LIMIT 5;

WITH gaps AS (
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements(requirements_gap) AS g
    FROM match_results m
    JOIN jobs j ON j.id = m.job_id
   WHERE j.discovered_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT g->>'skill' AS skill, count(*) AS n
  FROM gaps
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY n DESC
 LIMIT 10;
